data.code:
# .github/workflows/perf.yml
- name: k6 smoke test
  run: |
    k6 run --quiet \
      --out json=results.json \
      scripts/smoke.js
- name: Check budget
  run: |
    p99=$(jq '.metrics.http_req_duration.values."p(99)"' results.json)
    if (( $(echo "$p99 > 500" | bc -l) )); then
      echo "p99 $p99ms > budget 500ms" && exit 1
    fi

data.content: Pra frontend: Lighthouse-ci com budget.json. LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1. Bundle size com bundlewatch. PR bloqueia se regressão.
